title: Parallel Courses
description: There are `n` courses labeled 1 through `n`. Each relation `[a,b]` means course `a` must be completed before course `b`. Any number of courses may be taken in one semester if all prerequisites are complete. Return the minimum number of semesters needed, or -1 if the requirements contain a cycle.
hints: Model each ordering rule as a directed edge.
Use indegrees to process prerequisites and identify cycles or forced choices.
